purpose: Smooth Low-RPM Drivability & Crisp High-RPM Decel Pops

changes_since_previous_run: Derived from paired-20261104-075425-a8636a50-v030 log analysis: (1) Completely disables Tip-In Torque Control spark chops by raising [ECM] 44607 to 7,500 RPM, eliminating the 2,400 RPM oscillation boundary that caused 561 torque-cut chops; (2) Shortens [ECM] 44496 DFCO delay from 1.75s to 0.90s for a concise, punchy pop burst; (3) Re-cushions [ECM] 44605 decel spark at 2,000 RPM (+10.0 deg) and 3,000 RPM (+2.0 deg) to prevent tip-in bogging, while deepening 4,000-6,000 RPM to -8.0 deg ATDC for louder, sharper pops on overrun; (4) Trims [ECM] 12163 MAF Columns 14-17 by -2.5% to zero out cruising STFT.
